## Editorial analysis

- **Issue with previous #006:** true 5/5 test, but too narrow for "how to learn LLMs from GitHub"; little project discovery, learning roadmap or note-taking outcome. Causal mask is now chapter 7, not the whole post theme.
- **3 revised angles:** (1) bookmarks-to-proof learning pipeline **chosen** (27/30 editorial score); (2) choosing an appropriate repo by prerequisites (25/30); (3) lab-first route before heavyweight training (24/30).
- **Strongest counterpoint:** saving notes and running a one-dimensional causal attention test does not establish competent LLM engineering. It's a start, not mastery. The full curriculum requires many further lessons and updated dependencies.
- **Evidence boundaries:** actual toy experiment PASS under Linux/Python 3.13.5, five unit tests; general 13-section GitHub account UI walkthrough NOT independently performed from a fresh reader account; entire Datawhale training NOT executed.
- **Sources:** [GitHub search documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/search-github/searching-on-github/searching-for-repositories), [Datawhale DIY-LLM](https://github.com/datawhalechina/diy-llm), [Datawhale Self-LLM](https://github.com/datawhalechina/self-llm), [Microsoft 21-lesson course](https://github.com/microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners).

## English X Thread proposal (2 posts, no broken private link)

### Post 1 — attach actual cover PNG

```text
Most people don’t fail at learning LLMs because of math.

They fail at turning GitHub bookmarks into practice.

A better path:
1. Find 3 credible repos
2. Choose ONE runnable lesson
3. Save the output in your own learning repo

I built a 13-step guide around that workflow.
```

- X weighted estimate: 273 characters.

### Post 2 — provide public SOURCE curriculum, not a false public original guide

```text
Your first deliverable shouldn't be a trained 7B model.

Make an `llm-learning-notes` repo: sources, pinned versions, one actual test result, errors, and the next task.

Start with the public Datawhale curriculum: https://datawhalechina.github.io/diy-llm/
```

- X weighted estimate: 237 characters.

1/ 大多数人在 GitHub 学 LLM 时遇到的问题，并非数学知识不足，而是无法把 GitHub 收藏转化为实际练习。更好的学习方式是：找三个可靠仓库、挑一个可运行的章节、把结果留在自己的学习仓库。我围绕这条路线写了一份 13 步长教程。
